cover_headline: Google Dismantles XCPE Botnet Hidden in 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes

end.headline: Google Dismantles XCPE Botnet Hidden in 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes
end.line: Google says Videostrong intentionally preloaded a firmware backdoor that turned its set-top boxes into a proxy and ad-fraud botnet, and it has banned the company from certified Android devices after a coordinated takedown.

facts: Google and partners dismantled the XCPE botnet, which had enrolled more than 1.3 million set-top boxes, and Google assesses with high confidence that Videostrong intentionally built the backdoor for financial gain
The backdoor was preloaded in firmware with system privileges, disabled Google Play Protect, and if uninstalled it reinstalls from the /oem/ partition on reboot
Google took legal action it assesses will sever access to at least 10 million more compromised devices, and banned Videostrong from certified Android devices
